feature: Global dashboard home and workspace directory
problem: The current dashboard route is only a Workspace directory, so it does not provide a global view of the Identity Projects and Workspaces already available to an authenticated account.
invariants: The global Identity Project directory is a live read and does not persist or mirror Identity records.
Rendering an Identity Project on Home does not link it to a Workspace or mutate Identity state.
Workspace visibility remains scoped to direct active Workspace membership.
The Workspaces navigation item routes to the existing Workspace directory; Home remains the global dashboard route.

context.outcome: A signed-in account can see its accessible Identity Projects and Workspaces from one global Home, while a dedicated Workspaces page remains the place to browse and open Workspaces.
context.scope: Identity Project summaries are scoped by the current user's Identity authorization. Workspace summaries are scoped by direct active Workspace membership.

useCases.name: Read the global Home
preconditions: Caller has an authenticated Platform session
Identity Project listing uses the current user's Identity bearer
useCases.result: Return the caller-authorized Identity Project summaries and accessible Workspace summaries as independent sections, preserving each section's loading, empty, access-needed, or unavailable state.

useCases.name: Browse Workspaces
preconditions: Caller has a trusted authenticated Identity subject
useCases.result: List active Workspaces the account can access and allow the caller to open one.

policies: Identity remains the source of truth for Identity Project data and authorization; only the signed-in user's bearer may be used for the global project directory.
Workspace visibility remains scoped to direct active Workspace membership; global Home does not widen Workspace access.
Identity 403 and upstream failure are represented as generic access-needed or unavailable states without credentials or private Identity configuration.
Identity and Workspace sections fail independently so one upstream outage does not hide successful data from the other section.
invariants: The global Identity Project directory is a live read and does not persist or mirror Identity records.
Rendering an Identity Project on Home does not link it to a Workspace or mutate Identity state.
The Workspaces navigation item routes to the existing Workspace directory; Home remains the global dashboard route.

readModels.name: GlobalHome
readModels.purpose: Render caller-authorized Identity Project summaries and directly accessible Workspaces in separate sections.
readModels.source: Live Identity API project listing with the caller's bearer plus the existing membership-scoped Platform Workspace directory.

readModels.name: WorkspaceDirectory
readModels.purpose: Browse and open the caller's accessible Workspaces from a dedicated navigation item.
readModels.source: Existing Platform Workspace list and default-workspace provisioning behavior.

boundaries.domainOwner: talred-starter/apps/platform-api PlatformWorkspace and PlatformOrganization contexts; read-only project directory composes the existing Identity gateway
boundaries.persistence: No new persistence; Identity Project details remain in talred-identity and Workspace membership remains in Platform API
boundaries.api: Authenticated Platform API exposes a read-only global Identity Project summary endpoint; existing Workspace list contract remains unchanged
boundaries.bff: talred-starter/apps/web server/api/platform forwards the signed-in request to the Platform API without exposing bearer credentials to browser code
boundaries.client: Starter dashboard renders a global Home with Identity Projects and Workspaces sections; /dashboard/workspaces owns the Workspace directory UI
boundaries.identity: talred-identity remains authoritative; the Platform reads project summaries using the current user's authorization and does not infer permissions from Workspace roles
boundaries.runtime: Existing local-dev-ops Platform API, Identity, and Starter web services; no new service, provider, or secret

acceptanceCriteria: The dashboard Home shows a page title and short description, followed by distinct Identity Projects and Workspaces sections.
Identity Project summaries on Home come from a live authenticated Platform API read using the current user's bearer and contain no credentials or private configuration.
An Identity access denial or Identity outage produces a localized section state while the Workspace section can still render, and vice versa.
The Workspaces sidebar item opens /dashboard/workspaces, which retains the current directory, workspace creation, and workspace selection behavior.
Workspace cards on Home reuse the same card representation and open the selected Workspace.
English and French translations cover the Home sections and Identity loading, empty, access-needed, and unavailable states.

assumptions.statement: The Home Identity Projects section lists every project returned to the current user's Identity API project-list permission, including projects that are not linked to a Workspace.
Global Home displays lightweight Identity Project summaries only; detailed Identity configuration remains in Identity Console.

decisions: Keep Identity Projects and Workspaces as independent Home resource sections; do not imply that a Workspace owns every Identity Project shown globally.
Use live caller-authorized Identity reads and the existing membership-scoped Workspace API; do not add a local Identity projection or cross-workspace fan-out.
Keep Workspace directory navigation separate from the global Home while reusing its existing workspace cards and create flow.
